boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 134 is a Hard vertical board embedding orange keys, blue locks, and wrench tools directly in the block field alongside purple `12` towers and a top `15` strip. The padlocked cyan tile guards the main exit lane, and the key and lock sit on opposite sides — the middle cyan bar must shift left before the key can reach the lock, or the left-arrow lane seals.
landmarks: Block Out Level 134 is a Hard vertical board embedding orange keys, blue locks, and wrench tools directly in the block field alongside purple `12` towers and a top `15` strip.
The padlocked cyan tile guards the main exit lane, and the key and lock sit on opposite sides — the middle cyan bar must shift left before the key can reach the lock, or the left-arrow lane seals.
The board mixes Purple, Blue, Cyan and more.
The opening layout is a color-sort grid.
Clear matched tiles to finish the level.

quickTips: Clear the blue 7 pocket before touching the locked cyan tile in the bottom cluster.
Match the key to the lock before using the wrench tools on the purple L-base.
Think in chain clears. The best move is the one that sets up the next two moves, not just the quickest current match.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Break the top 15 strip and the three purple 12 towers without touching the locked cyan tile in the bottom cluster.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Clear the lower-left blue 7 pocket to expose the bottom 9 and 4 counters.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Match the orange key on the left-center band to the blue lock on the right-center.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Use the orange wrench tools on the left and right flanks to free the purple L-base blocks.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Slide the middle cyan/light-blue bar through the left-arrow lane once the key-lock pair clears.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Feed the remaining red and pink scraps down the red and blue bottom downward arrows.

steps.title: Move 7
steps.instruction: Clear the last purple base blocks for the Hard Level board clear.

failurePoints: Detonating a bomb tile beside the locked cyan block before the 7 pocket clears, sealing the 9/4 gate.
Moving the purple L-base before the key-lock pair clears, re-blocking the bottom downward arrows.
